label: Спать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for спать (to sleep).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Сплю' is the -ю form of спать, with the inserted л after the stem labial. 'Восемь часов' gives the typical duration of the ongoing habit.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Спишь' shows the -ишь ending of спать without the л insert, which appears only in the first person. The imperfective fits an ongoing state.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Спит' is the core -ит form of спать. 'В своей кроватке' uses в with the prepositional case for static location.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Спим' takes the -им ending. 'С открытым окном' uses с with the instrumental to describe the circumstances of sleeping.
Strategic focus: Polite or plural present. 'Спите' is the respectful -ите form of спать. 'После обеда' uses после with the genitive to frame a habitual nap.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Спят' closes the person ladder with the -ят ending. 'Почти весь день' stresses the long, ongoing rest.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Спал' is the masculine -л past of спать. 'Очень плохо' describes the quality of the night's sleep.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Спала' adds the feminine -ла ending. 'До самого утра' uses до with the genitive to mark the limit of the sleep.
Strategic focus: Imperfective future. 'Буду' is the auxiliary and 'спать' stays infinitive in the compound future. The imperfective suits the durative idea of sleeping a long time.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Спи' is the informal command of спать. 'Спокойно' softens it into a gentle goodnight wish.
